sources.entry: yGraph Editor - High quality diagrams made easy.

summary.name: yEd Graph Editor
summary.one_liner: yEd is a free desktop diagram editor for creating, importing, editing and automatically arranging graphs and diagrams such as flowcharts, BPMN, UML class diagrams and family trees.
use_cases: map family trees or social networks
visualize large imported data sets as graphs
export diagrams as vector or bitmap graphics
summary.what_it_does: yEd is a desktop application for creating diagrams manually or importing external data, including Excel (.xls) spreadsheets and XML files. Its automatic layout algorithms can arrange diagram elements, including large data sets, with a single action. Diagrams can be exported as PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF or SWF. The page lists supported diagram types such as BPMN, semantic networks, family trees, flowcharts, social networks and UML class diagrams. yEd is built on the yFiles graph library and is a pure Java Swing application.
notable: Automatic layout algorithms arrange large diagrams with one button press
Imports Excel (.xls) spreadsheets and XML data
Built on the yFiles diagramming library
caveats: Requires a suitable Java Runtime Environment to be installed
Page mentions an online editor and Atlassian Confluence integration, which are separate products and not described in detail here
